name: paper-to-figma
description: Turn your paper into publication-ready figures: an agent draws them as editable Figma frames, with every number checked against the paper.

scripts.build:plugin: bun build plugin/main.js --outfile plugin/code.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.build:kit: bun build kit/index.js --outfile kit/dist/kit.js --target browser --format iife
scripts.build: bun run build:kit && bun run build:plugin
